explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/618: for triangle-free G, h_2(G) is the least number of edges to add so that the graph has diameter 2 and stays triangle-free; 'Is it true that if G has maximum degree o(n^{1/2}) then h(G) = o(n^2)?' (yes, by Alon's note). `h2 G` is the sInf of |E(H) \ E(G)| over triangle-free supergraphs H in which any two distinct vertices are adjacent or share a neighbour (diameter <= 2). Such H always exists for triangle-free G (a maximal triangle-free supergraph has this property), so sInf is genuine. The asymptotic hypothesis and conclusion are expressed for an arbitrary sequence of triangle-free graphs G n on Fin n, the standard reading of the o(·) statement. Faithful.
